name: dot-grid
title: Dot Grid
description: A dot grid with a fine grain and soft edges. Dots near the cursor take the primary color and grow.

props.name: glow
props.description: Light up and grow the dots near the cursor. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

props.name: glowRadius
props.description: Radius of the cursor glow, in pixels.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the grid out towards the edges.

props.name: noise
props.description: Lay a fine film grain over the grid.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
